shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books in my free time.
She runs every morning to stay fit.
They are planning a trip to the mountains.
He studies hard to improve his grades.
We often watch movies together on weekends.
My friends and I play soccer in the park.
Traveling to new places broadens our perspectives.
Learning a new language can be challenging but fun.
Volunteering helps the community and enriches our lives.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel planning.
questions: Q1: Can you tell me about a memorable trip you've taken?
Q2: What kind of challenges did you face while planning that trip?
Q3: How do you feel about the importance of travel in our lives?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about eco-friendly habits.
questions: Q1: What eco-friendly habits do you practice in your daily life?
Q2: Have you encountered any difficulties in maintaining these habits?
Q3: What is your opinion on the impact of individual actions on the environment?
Q4: How would you encourage others to adopt more eco-friendly practices?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about creative hobbies.
questions: Q1: What creative hobby do you enjoy and why?
Q2: Have you faced any obstacles in pursuing your hobby?
Q3: Why do you think creative hobbies are important for personal growth?
Q4: What tips would you give someone looking to start a creative hobby?
